title: BaselineProfile
description: Phase-0 artifact. Diagnostic profile of the vanilla baseline model BEFORE any mechanism is proposed. Adapter writes `data`; agent writes `analysis`. P0 discipline blocks Phase-1 until this file exists with a non-empty `analysis.candidate_failure_modes`.

baseline_id.description: Stable id for the baseline state (e.g. 'yolov8s_pretrained').

data.description: Adapter-produced raw data. Sections that the adapter cannot produce (raise NotImplementedError) are simply absent — the agent reads what's available and notes the gap.

per_class_metric.description: One entry per class. Sorted ascending by `value` is conventional but not required.

support_count.description: Number of test units containing this class.

per_scale_metric.description: Adapter-defined scale buckets. COCO convention: small/medium/large.

per_site_recall_contribution.description: If the model has multi-scale heads (FPN), recall contribution per head.

loss_decomposition.description: Loss-term magnitudes at end-of-training. Keys are adapter-defined (e.g. 'box', 'cls', 'obj' for YOLO).

top_failure_units.description: K worst test units by primary metric. Used as evidence for candidate_failure_modes.

model_topology_summary.description: Inline copy of the subset of adapter.describe_model() relevant for failure attribution. Optional convenience for the agent.

analysis.description: Agent-produced interpretation. Required: candidate_failure_modes (the bridge to Phase-1).

summary.description: Plain-English summary of what the diagnostic data shows.

candidate_failure_modes.description: Hypothesized failure modes of the BASELINE. Phase-1 experiments cite these IDs in `cites_baseline_finding_ids`. Same shape as anchor_profile failure_mode_ids.

evidence.description: Cite the data section that supports this. e.g. 'per_scale_metric.small=0.21 vs large=0.58; top_failure_units 12/20 tagged small_box'.

suggested_intervention_modes.description: Optional. e.g. ['patch-mode@neck.c2f_15 for P3-feature enhancement', 'R2-aux: scale-balanced focal loss']. Advisory only.

gaps.description: Diagnostic sections that were unavailable (NotImplementedError) — useful for prioritizing adapter work.
